name: Aerid Konstrari
description: A sphinx who animates inert materials using heartwood crystals charged from the leyline confluence under Hexhaven and has taught followers to build huge constructs.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: An elder sphinx born of red and green leylines who animates inert materials with a heartwood crystal.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.
